answers.core: This is how it works in other engines that have equivalent features. Also, doing anything else in the inspector, such as changing a value, affects all selected objects, so there's no reason tool buttons should be different.
answers.workaround:
The current workaround is to use a `for` loop with `EditorInterface.get_selection().get_selected_nodes()`
```
for obj in EditorInterface.get_selection().get_selected_nodes():
	# do stuff
```

title: If multiple objects are selected, tool button actions (added with `@export_tool_button`) should be invoked on all of them
